subject.title: [Feature]: Add guarded keyboard shortcuts for session/agent switching in Control UI

question: Should Control UI support guarded positional/cyclic session or agent switching shortcuts, and what bindings plus ordering should be the supported contract?
rationale: This is new active-session behavior, not a broken existing contract; the proposed chords can conflict with browser/OS shortcuts and require a product decision about which sessions or agents occupy positions 1-9.

options.title: Add Coordinated Guarded Shortcuts
options.body: Adopt non-conflicting bindings and implement them through the same guarded dashboard shortcut path, with tests for editable guards and active-session ordering.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions View
options.body: Keep this tracked under the broader sessions-view work so keyboard switching lands with a richer overview/list contract instead of as standalone chords.

options.title: Decline Browser-Level Chords
options.body: Keep session switching picker/sidebar or command-palette driven if maintainers decide browser-level session chords are too conflict-prone.

recommendation.title: Add Coordinated Guarded Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Adopt non-conflicting bindings and implement them through the same guarded dashboard shortcut path, with tests for editable guards and active-session ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the adjacent guarded dashboard shortcut issue/PR and has the closest current product context for shortcut-contract choices.
